title: Exact fixed-sector Jacobi moments, edge nonresonance and prior scattering bounds
statement: For a fundamental coordinate shear and nonzero transverse integer frequency xi, alpha=|xi|>=1, the in-plane exact selfadjoint compression J_alpha=P*cos(y) has zero diagonal and a_n=[alpha^2+n(n+1)]/[2sqrt(alpha^2+n^2)*sqrt(alpha^2+(n+1)^2)]=cos(theta_n)/2,theta_n=integral_n^(n+1)alpha/(alpha^2+x^2)dx. The other polarisation is free cosine Jacobi. Angle monotonicity gives1/(2sqrt2)<=a_n<1/2; Cauchy-Schwarz bounds1-cos(theta_n) by(1/2)integral alpha^2/(alpha^2+x^2)^2. Elementary integrals give sum(1+|n|)|a_n-1/2|<=pi/(4alpha)+1/4; sum(1+|n|)^2|a_n-1/2|<=pi/(2alpha)+1+pi*alpha/8; trace-norm||J_alpha-J_free||<=pi/(4alpha). Third moments diverge since|a_n-1/2|~alpha^2/(4n^4). Positive form <f,(I-J)f>=sum a_n|f_(n+1)-f_n|^2+sum V_n|f_n|^2,V_n=1-a_n-a_(n-1)>0, excludes bounded +1 solutions: cutoffchi_N with slopes<=2/N gives E(chi_N psi)<=C||psi||infinity^2/N, so fixed-site V_n|psi_n|^2=0 in the limit. Staggering excludes bounded -1 solutions too. ROOT-read prior Egorova-Holzleitner-Teschl1506.06555v2 Thms1.1-1.2/Section2 therefore applies: first moment and contraction give pure ac spectrum, ell1->ellinfinity O_alpha(t^-1/3); SECOND moment plus BOTH-edge nonresonance gives weighted ell1_2->ellinfinity_-2 O_alpha(t^-4/3). These are prior scattering applications in operator time with operator-dependent constants, not a new generic theorem or computable uniform polynomial bound. Staticphase is a gauge and actual physical time scale2pi*(a_prime.xi) may vanish/approach zero. No uniform calibrated composition or nonlinear fixed-actuator controller follows; that distinct endpoint remains OPEN.
